name: HEARTH
description: Giant wood-fired sculpture at the Heart of Burning Man; co-designed/built with Syd Klinge; where Charlie met Brian Doherty

name: Synapses Tour
key_events: Six cities (NYC/Atlanta/Austin/LA/Seattle/SF) then Burning Man 2005 Fire Dream Circle
description: Six workshops in six cities over six months with Jaime Ladet; each city built and kept its own fire cauldron; shown at BM 2005 in the Fire Dream Circle around Pepe Ozan's Dreamer (with Flaming Lotus Girls)

name: Contraptions
description: His 2007 BM installation literally titled 'Contraptions' — the direct root of contraptionism.com

name: Triple Bypass
description: Studio-built over 6 weeks; helped instigate AfrikaBurn; described as the first Burning-Man-represented artifact there

name: Hot Mama
description: Part of the fertility-caldron series with Mr. Nice Guy and the Waking Rooster

name: Mr. Nice Guy
description: Companion to Hot Mama in the fertility caldron series

name: The Fleeble Flobbler
key_events: Burning Man 2008; Okeechobee; Suwannee Hulaween Spirit Lake 2023; festivals
description: 22-ft rotund clown fire cauldron with eight rider seats on a pivoting base; later a flame-effects machine; recurring at Hulaween Spirit Lake (2023)

name: Bone Head
description: Shown at Desert Rock Festival in Dubai

name: Teetering Cusps
key_events: Starlight Drive-In 2003; End of the World 2008
description: Recurring teetering fire piece across regional events

name: Tunnel of Transformation
description: Black Rock Arts Foundation grant 2003 (with Michael Moss; 4 of 117 chosen); toured US regional burns 2003-04

name: The Gantry
key_events: Steamboat Springs decom 2003; 'to the moon' TN 2024
description: Recurring metallic effigy; a 2024 example is used to illustrate Burning Book congregation

name: Ganesha
description: Large metal elephant-deity (Ganesha) effigy — rare build + detail shots from Okeechobee 2017; named by Charlie/KK in the 2023 interview

name: The Discombobulator
description: Austin Halloween fire show

name: 24/7 A Time Star
aka: Timing Is Everything (BM 2012) / A 24/7 Timestar Lives (BeltLine 2015)
key_events: Burning Man 2012 honorarium; Atlanta Historic 4th Ward 2015-2018 (debut at BeltLine Lantern Parade)
description: Seven-sided interactive star built by 100+ people; official BM 2012 title 'Timing Is Everything'; 24 ft; 2.5-yr Atlanta install via Art on the BeltLine + BRAF; local 'starfie' landmark

name: Uncle Charlie's Red Hot Cock
scale: 12'x30' base; 25-30 ft tall (50 ft per KK)
description: Jackal-headed rooster teeter-totter that burns wood; ~40 crew; 2-2.5 cords; KK was quartermaster/documentarian

name: The Solar Scope
description: Tuned mechanical sun/time device set on a 60-degree parallel; built with his cousin (a math artist)

name: The Burning Book of Brian
status: planned (independent; NOT an official BM honorarium)
themes: memorial; pulsing heart; the royal we
description: Memorial effigy for Brian Doherty with a pulsing LPG heart; community-built; 8-10 collaborating artists; independent/community-funded (not on the 75-project 2026 honoraria list)

name: Fire Birds of the Fifth Direction
key_events: Burning Man 2011 (Great Circle, around the Man)
themes: mythic birds; congregation; transformation into ONE
description: Four 12-ft wood-fired metal bird-creature cauldrons with cut patterns lit by internal fire at night and shadow-casting wings by day; surrounded the Man as congregation areas, transformed into "ONE" for a Saturday eruption. Same winged cut-panel design recurs at Okeechobee 2017.

name: Big Bully
description: A fire-spewing, winged, human-headed bull; participants lined up to throw logs into its mouth "as sacrifice." Confirms the long-mislabeled portfolio image bigbullysm.jpg.
sources: history.burningman.org 2013 art installations; GPT research note 2026

name: Infinite Infant and the Trail of Toys
description: A steel dunce-cap-wearing baby pulling metal play toys and shooting fire from its head, towing three older wheeled fire cauldrons from previous work — Charlie treating past sculptures as living components of a longer mythology.

name: Big Charles
description: CANDIDATE WORK — surfaced via 4 Burning Man gallery photos titled "Big Charles" (several by photographer Shane Evans), one captioned "Big Charles and Galaxia". Relationship to other works (or whether a nickname) unconfirmed — verify with Charlie.

name: Encompassment / Directional Vessels of Fire
description: CANDIDATE WORK — surfaced via a Burning Man gallery photo "Encompassment / Directional Vessels of Fire by Charlie..." Details unconfirmed; likely a directional fire-cauldron grouping in the Synapses lineage — verify with Charlie.
